name: NEXTDC M2 Melbourne Stage 1

lat.note: Geocoded 2026-09-27 from '75 Sharps Road, Tullamarine VIC 3043' with the ArcGIS World Geocoder (PointAddress, score 100); PeeringDB facility point (-37.70803, 144.87569) is ~90m away.

builder.note: FDC project page for NEXTDC M2 (base building, Data Hall 1, site remediation); stage not stated but Kapitol's portfolio starts at Stage 2 (Jan 2019), so FDC is taken as the Stage 1 builder. Later stages by Kapitol Group (source 6): see nextdc-m2-stage2, nextdc-m2-stage4, nextdc-m2-stage5, nextdc-m2-stage6, nextdc-m2-stage9-11

mw_it.note: This row is Stage 1 only (FDC base building, opened Nov 2017). No source states Stage 1's own IT capacity. At announcement (May 2016): 2MW initial, 25MW planned (source 1); FY17 AR: M2 target capacity raised to 40MW (source 3) - both are whole-site targets, not Stage 1. Derived estimate (not stated by any source): NEXTDC FY20 deck gives M2 installed capacity 10MW at 30 Jun 2020 (source 11), and Stage 2 (Jan 2019) added 6MW (source 6), leaving ~4MW for Stage 1; FY19 AR says M2's third data hall opened in FY19 (source 12) and Stage 2 had two data halls, so Stage 1 had one fitted data hall. The Stage 1 building's design capacity may exceed its ~4MW fitted capacity, but no figure was found. Later stages are separate rows: nextdc-m2-stage2 (6MW), nextdc-m2-stage4 (18MW), nextdc-m2-stage5 (15MW), nextdc-m2-stage6 (8MW), nextdc-m2-stage9-11 (60MW, under construction); campus now marketed as 120MW+ (source 7)

cost_aud_m.note: '$85 million' covering land, base building and infrastructure (May 2016 announcement as reported by iTnews and The Urban Developer). FY17 AR: B2 and M2 together 'an investment of over $100 million so far' (source 3)

authority.note: 75 Sharps Rd is in the City of Brimbank (Brimbank planning register; PlanningAlerts P341/2022 at 75 Sharps Rd, source 14), not Hume as earlier assumed

pathway.value: council planning permit (Planning and Environment Act 1987)

reference.note: the Brimbank register lists P589/2016 as the data centre permit for 75 Sharps Rd (amendments Pt 5-7, 2023-2025). The register starts Dec 2018, so the original 2016 grant is not listed; taking P589/2016 as the Stage 1 permit rests on its 2016 number and the site (inference)

lodged.note: 2016 per permit number; exact date not found

jobs_construction_other.note: The Urban Developer (23 May 2016): construction 'expected to support up to 200 jobs on and off-site' (iTnews: 'up to 200' direct jobs)
'up to 200 jobs on and off-site, with another 100 jobs supported deeper in the supply chain' = 300 total

construction_start.note: site acquired May 2016 (source 8); FY17 AR says development began during FY17 (Jul 2016-Jun 2017); exact start not found

construction_end.note: NEXTDC history: November 2017 'Victoria's first UTI Tier IV certified data centre' opened
